result.verdict: A-STABILITY SELECTS THE IRREP DIMENSION (structural, not a fit): among magnitude powers Δ_λ=sgn·dim_q^p, only p=1 (the irrep dimension) gives an A-BOUNDED binding ratio (d:0.18, t:0.30, 3he:0.40, 4he:0.21, spread <3x); p=2 (block dim²) blows up 40-450x with A. Since the physical binding is A-bounded, the A-stability criterion selects Δ_λ=sgn·dim — the #3542 IRREP TRACE — as the correct A-scaling, and confirms the #3558 block dim²≈101% on the deuteron was coincidental (wrong power). The remaining gap is an O(1) multiplicative factor (target/B(dim): d:5.5, t:3.4, 3he:2.5, 4he:4.9) — SAME power, missing coefficient — OPEN (derive, not fit). With the cross-isotope SIGN validation (#3558), the picture is Δ_λ = O(1)·sgn·dim(λ), O(1) the only unknown. NOTHING WIRED.
